gloss: first ten days of a month; early part of a month

definitions.gloss: first ten days of a month; early part of a month
definitions.explanation: The first third of a month, roughly days 1-10. Part of a three-way division of the month into 初旬 (early), 中旬 (mid), and 下旬 (late). Composed of 初 (beginning) + 旬 (ten-day period).

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{四月|しがつ}{初旬|しょじゅん}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The meeting will be held in early April.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}は{六月|ろくがつ}{初旬|しょじゅん}から{始|はじ}まることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The rainy season often begins in early June.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{締|し}め{切|き}りは{来月|らいげつ}{初旬|しょじゅん}の{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The report deadline is scheduled for early next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{初旬|しょじゅん} is used in both formal and everyday contexts when specifying an approximate time within a month. It forms a set with {中旬|ちゅうじゅん} (mid-month, roughly days 11-20) and {下旬|げじゅん} (late month, roughly days 21-end).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{月|がつ}{初旬|しょじゅん} (early [month])
- {初旬|しょじゅん}に (in the early part of the month)
- {初旬|しょじゅん}から (from the early part of the month)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{上旬|じょうじゅん} is a synonym with the same meaning. {初旬|しょじゅん} and {上旬|じょうじゅん} are interchangeable, though {上旬|じょうじゅん} is slightly more common.
